attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript and Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 13th November 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR6,625 million, up 43% year-over-year. Half-year revenue stood at INR11,793 million, with half-year profit after tax at INR1,057 million. Management cited strong domestic demand driven by vehicle replacement cycles and infrastructure growth. The industry volume outlook for the year is projected to exceed 500,000 units. Capacity expansion phase one is operational, addressing current demand, while phase two strategy is under evaluation. Export opportunities are being explored as domestic capacities are fully utilized. The company confirmed it does not manufacture air suspensions but its axles are compatible with such systems. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication w.r.t Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended 30th September 2026 of the Company.
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on 12th November 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 601.35 million rupees for the three months ended 30th September 2026 and 1,057.31 million rupees for the six months ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated net profit after tax was 2,887.52 million rupees for the quarter and 5,291.54 million rupees for the half year. HD Fire Protect Limited also disclosed its unaudited financial results for the same period, approved by the Board on 12th November 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 2,888.78 million rupees for the quarter and 5,292.80 million rupees for the half year. Shalimar Wires Industries Limited disclosed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board on 13th November 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 293.66 million rupees for the quarter and 513.41 million rupees for the half year.

attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome and Audio Recording of Analyst/Investor Conference Call to discuss on the  Automotive Axles Limited 2QFY27 Financial Performance  held on Friday, 13th November 2026 at 10:00 AM (IST).
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited disclosed the outcome of its Analyst and Investor Conference Call held on 13th November 2026 at 10:00 AM IST. The call focused on the company's 2QFY27 Financial Performance. This disclosure follows an earlier intimation dated 09th November 2026. The audio recording of the conference call is available on the company website at www.autoaxle.com/investormeet. The announcement was signed by Debadas Panda, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Raman K as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026 in the regular capacity.
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also appointed Mr. Raman K as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel effective November 12, 2026, superseding his interim role. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 6,625.55 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 601.35 million rupees. Earnings per share stood at 39.79. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 11,793.76 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 1,057.31 million rupees. Earnings per share were 69.96. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 15,691.02 million rupees. The Limited Review Report by S R Batliboi & Associates LLP is enclosed.
